What it held, what it means for advocates, and a checklist before you file. Pooja Ramesh Singh (2026) Vijay Ghanshyam Gadiya (2026) Verification checklist Adv. CASE 1 · THE LEADING RULING Pooja Ramesh Singh v. J&K Bank Ltd. DECIDED BENCH 2 July 2026 Narasimha & 2026 INSC 668 · C.A. 11950 Aradhe, JJ. of 2025 Supreme Court of India WHAT WENT WRONG 6 citations, none reliable The NCLT relied on judgments that were non-existent, wrongly titled or had non-existent paragraphs. The NCLAT affirmed without checking them. RESULT Both orders set aside Insolvency petition restored before the NCLT for fresh decision; status quo meanwhile. Adv. Ashwani Kumar 02 / 07

Zero tolerance, not zero AI “A decision … based on material which is fake and hallucinated is no decision at all.” Pooja Ramesh Singh, 2026 INSC 668 1 Citing AI-generated precedents without verification is professional misconduct by an advocate. lapse. The decision must be set aside. 3 Bar Council of India directed to form a committee to frame guiding principles and disciplinary action. ✓ Legitimate use of AI in legal practice is not restricted. Adv. Ashwani Kumar 03 / 07

Vijay Ghanshyam Gadiya v. Union of India ₹425 crore Customs penalty set aside · 2 Sept 2026 · Datta & Nagu, JJ. ! The adjudicating officer's order relied on non- existent cases, fake citations and real cases that did not say what was attributed to them. → Order-in-Original and the Gujarat High Court's order set aside; matter remanded to a different officer of the same rank. “Assistance can never be substituted for adjudication.” Adv. Ashwani Kumar 04 / 07

“The machine neither signs the pleading nor owes duties to the court.” Bar Council of India, in its response to Parliament (June 2026) § Advocates Act, 1961, s. 35: misconduct can lead to reprimand, suspension or removal from the roll. ✎ The advocate on record answers for every citation and quotation, however it was researched. “The AI did it” is not a defence. 🔒 Don't paste privileged communications, client instructions or case strategy into tools that are not secure. Adv. Ashwani Kumar 05 / 07

BEFORE YOU FILE A 7-point citation check Pull every judgment from SCC Online, Manupatra or the court's website, not from the AI's answer Match the case title, citation, bench and date Open the paragraph you cite and confirm it says what you claim Check it is still good law: not overruled, reversed or distinguished Check statutory references against the current Bare Act (IPC → BNS, CrPC → BNSS) Never cite a judgment you have not read yourself Keep client-confidential material out of public AI tools Adv. Ashwani Kumar 06 / 07

TA K E AWAY Use AI to research faster, not to replace research. The Court has drawn the line clearly: AI can assist, but the advocate and the adjudicator must verify. An unchecked citation now risks the case and the advocate's career. Adv.
